verdict.rationale: Meilisearch is a search/database backend, not an AI agent or assistant that itself consumes MCP tools; the evidence shows the reverse relationship — Meilisearch ships an official MCP *server* so AI clients (e.g., Claude) can call ITS search tools (meilisearch-docs-13, meilisearch-docs-57, meilisearch-probe-4), not that Meilisearch plugs in external MCP servers to gain their tools. Acting as an MCP client/host is outside this product's category.
